title: Google Ads
description: Campaigns and their metrics in Google Ads

fields.label: Developer token
fields.help: Google Ads API developer token; an umbrella Google connection has none, so set the node's Developer token field.

operations.title: Get many campaigns
operations.description: Metric names ending in micros are in millionths of the account currency.

fields.label: Options
fields.help: dateRange: allTime (default), TODAY, YESTERDAY, LAST_7_DAYS, LAST_BUSINESS_WEEK, THIS_MONTH, LAST_MONTH, LAST_14_DAYS, LAST_30_DAYS; campaignStatus: all, ENABLED, PAUSED, REMOVED.

fields.label: Developer token
fields.help: Google Ads API developer token (used when the connection has none).

body.query: select campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign_budget.amount_micros, campaign_budget.period, campaign.status, campaign.optimization_score, campaign.advertising_channel_type, campaign.advertising_channel_sub_type, metrics.impressions, metrics.interactions, metrics.interaction_rate, metrics.average_cost, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.conversions, metrics.cost_per_conversion, metrics.conversions_from_interactions_rate, metrics.video_trueview_views, metrics.average_cpm, metrics.ctr from campaign where campaign.id > 0{{ p.additionalOptions.dateRange | ne:'allTime' | then:p.additionalOptions.dateRange | prefix:' and segments.date DURING ' }}{{ p.additionalOptions.campaignStatus | ne:'all' | then:p.additionalOptions.campaignStatus | prefix:" and campaign.status = '" | suffix:"'" }}

select campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign_budget.amount_micros, campaign_budget.period, campaign.status, campaign.optimization_score, campaign.advertising_channel_type, campaign.advertising_channel_sub_type, metrics.impressions, metrics.interactions, metrics.interaction_rate, metrics.average_cost, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.conversions, metrics.cost_per_conversion, metrics.conversions_from_interactions_rate, metrics.video_trueview_views, metrics.average_cpm, metrics.ctr from campaign where campaign.id = {{ p.campaignId | string | replace:'-','' }}
